job.title: Cook
job.description:
Ambassador Personnel is hiring a Cook in Savannah, GA (2 openings). This is a temporary assignment through Ambassador Personnel.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare and cook food following recipes and portion standards
  • Follow safe food handling, temperature and sanitation rules
  • Set up, clean and break down your station
  • Help the kitchen turn out large batches on schedule

Requirements

  • Able to stand for a full shift and lift up to 35 lbs
  • Able to follow recipes and food safety rules
  • Kitchen experience a plus
  • No diploma required.

Schedule

  • Mon-Fri 6am-2pm

Pay and benefits

  • Pay: $19.00/hr
  • Weekly pay

How to apply

Apply online or call (912) 330-7210.
